name: Maestro: All Aboard!
summary:
All Aboard!

Hoist the canvas and take the helm, for a booty-laden Content Update is rumored to be buried somewhere in Maestro!

Follow the culture map and lead the most ragged, salt-soaked scurvy scummy scallywags cutnote musyc-mongerin’ miscreants blossoming cockroaches of an orchestra through five treasures o’ rarest sound.
Hear hear, the cannon-blastin’ Pirates of the Caribbean themes from the quill of Hans Zimmer himself, sea shanties sung by the drunkest of mates and authentic symphonies of the most classical orrrderrrrr…

Yer pirated music pieces :

• Zimmer & Badelt – “He’s a Pirate” (from Pirates of the Caribbean)
• Zimmer – “Jack Sparrow” (from Pirates of the Caribbean)
• Unknown Author - “Wellerman”
• Rimski-Korsakov – The Shipwreck (From Scheherazade)
• Vaughan-Williams – A Sea Symphony (Overture)

Seize command of La Cultivée, summon your mighty Buccaneers crew, grab yer Kraken’s foot and set sail to find the hidden pirate culture. And remember Capt’n: an X sharp always marks the spot!
